svg.title: Left: share of synthetic datasets in which the naive PSR and the deflated Sharpe ratio accept the best configuration, against the true Sharpe ratio of the best configuration. Right: mean in-sample best, walk-forward, CPCV mean path and true Sharpe ratios against the same axis.
